title: Sakuya3
license: PeriTune terms: free, credit optional (released under CC BY 4.0, credit waived by the artist)
description: Like Ripples but with a shakuhachi flute, violin and piano joining the koto in a slow (85 bpm) "elegant, relaxed" Japanese piece with no drums, though a steady eighth-note koto/piano pattern runs through it, it is mastered much louder (-9 LUFS, so it must be turned down) and it has one quieter middle section; no credit needed.
loopNote: Starts at full level with no fade-in; fades out over about 4 s, then 2.2 s of silence. The page offers an official loop version (zip) that should loop without a seam; otherwise trim the silence and crossfade 3 s.
